notes: Format-faithful synthetic copies of the Board's three news-events JSON feeds, mirroring live captures: every file begins with a UTF-8 BOM (as the live feeds do — JSON.parse fails without stripping it), items use single-letter field names (d = 'M/D/YYYY h:mm:ss AM/PM' US-Eastern datetime, t = title, s = speaker, lo = location/venue, l = relative link, a = addendum note, v = video link sometimes, video = Yes/No, pt = press category on ne-press.json only). ne-speeches.json exercises a blank lo (venue null), a filled a (note kept), and a filled relative v (absolutized videoUrl). ne-press.json mixes pt values: three 'Monetary Policy' items (an FOMC minutes title → type minutes; 'Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement' → type statement; the Board's discount-rate minutes → plain pressRelease) plus one 'Orders on Banking Applications' and one 'Enforcement Actions' item that must be filtered out (out of scope, not parse failures). All names/links are synthetic; the shapes mirror the live feeds verbatim.
